tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: fg-0, fg-1, fg-2, accent.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, navigation, the Fork columns.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Elevated or hover surface. Muted text (fg-2) only at 14px and above here (4.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders. Decorative only; a border that carries meaning uses error or accent-strong.

tokens.name: fg-0
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 15.3:1 dark, 16.0:1 light on bg-0.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, body in cards. 9.6:1 dark, 7.9:1 light on bg-0.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Muted text, labels, placeholders. 5.6:1 dark, 5.1:1 light on bg-0.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lamp amber as text: links, inline highlights, the seam. 9.8:1 dark, 6.4:1 light on bg-0. Never a category colour.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Lamp amber as surface: primary button fill, progress, focus ring. 11.9:1 dark, 3.4:1 light against bg-0 (UI 3:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-strong. 11.9:1 dark, 4.7:1 light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint at 8-10% for hover fills and cursor halos.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status: in progress (dot + label). 8.7:1 dark, 5.8:1 light on bg-0.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status: done (check + label). 9.0:1 dark, 4.8:1 light on bg-0.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions, always with an icon and text. 7.1:1 dark, 5.8:1 light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px, offset 2px of bg-0, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: figure-shadow
tokens.usage: Synthetic contact shadow under the figure and the chair.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name, two lines. Fluid: clamp(2.75rem, 1.5rem + 8vw, 8.5rem); width axis 88.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles and the Fork heading. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3.2vw, 3.75rem).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Column and page titles. Fluid: clamp(1.5rem, 1.1rem + 1.6vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: The statement and introductions. Fluid: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.375rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Running text at a 60-68 character measure.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Base unit; hairline gaps.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: s-4

tokens.name: s-5

tokens.name: s-6

tokens.name: s-7

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Section padding minimum.

tokens.name: s-9
tokens.usage: Section padding at tablet.

tokens.name: s-10

tokens.name: s-11
tokens.usage: Hero to statement breathing room at wide screens.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Reserved right rail for the seated mark on Home at 1280px and up.

tokens.name: r-1
tokens.usage: Chips.

tokens.name: r-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, inputs.

tokens.name: r-3
tokens.usage: Media and galleries.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the cursor ring.

shadow.note: The dark theme uses borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards on the light theme.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards on the light theme.

duration.note: Durations for triggered motion; scrubbed motion has no duration.

tokens.name: d-fast
tokens.usage: State changes: chips, icon buttons.

tokens.name: d-base
tokens.usage: Hover, underline draw, cursor morph.

tokens.name: d-slow
tokens.usage: Small reveals, staggered groups.

tokens.name: d-scene
tokens.usage: Loader split, section planes, Fork columns settle (up to 800ms).

tokens.name: e-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or settling (ease-out quint).

tokens.name: e-inout
tokens.usage: Planes, loader split, path transitions.

tokens.name: e-linear
tokens.usage: Everything scrubbed by scroll.

motionscale.note: Distances and magnitudes for motion; reduced motion sets them to zero.

tokens.name: m-8
tokens.usage: Enter distance for chips and small text.

tokens.name: m-16
tokens.usage: Enter distance for rows.

tokens.name: m-24
tokens.usage: Enter distance for cards.

tokens.name: m-40
tokens.usage: Fork columns slide in from +-40px.

tokens.name: rot-card
tokens.usage: Card tilt maximum toward the pointer.

tokens.name: rot-col
tokens.usage: Fork columns open from +-8deg.

tokens.name: tilt-hero
tokens.usage: Hero stage tilt toward the pointer.

tokens.name: magnet
tokens.usage: Magnetic pull of buttons on fine pointers.

tokens.name: scale-back
tokens.usage: The previous section recedes under the next.
